from manim import *
from manim_physics import *

class PendulumLarge(SpaceScene):
    def construct(self):
        p = Pendulum(
            length=4,
            initial_theta=0.6,
            pivot_point=UP * 3,
            bob_style={"radius": 0.3, "color": BLUE, "fill_opacity": 1},
        )
        self.add(p)
        self.make_rigid_body(*p.bobs)
        p.start_swinging()
        self.wait(2)
